name: SaR Oracle
description: A signed reading of how far a book would slip if a share of open interest had to be traded. This version has no public dashboard and publishes no dollar amounts.

name: Panic Button
description: A read-only digest of approvals on the chains the approval-hygiene checker reads. It signs nothing and it has no web page.

name: RWA Pre-check
description: Read-only flags on one real-world-asset contract: which interface it exposes, how old its oracle answer is, and which admin powers it keeps.

name: Risk Scanner
description: How many LayerZero verifiers must agree before an app takes a message, read from the chain. A count, not a verdict.

name: Claw Guard
description: A verdict on a transaction or a signature before it is signed, on the chains the guard reads.

name: Allowance X-ray
description: Allowances a wallet has already granted, and Solana delegates, read without signing.

name: Sandwich restitution
description: A shadow record of a same-pool front and back on Solana. Nothing is paid, and there is no public dashboard.

name: Kink Cap
description: Hourly caps on the Hyperliquid USDC borrow rate. The page shows utilization and the rate. Testnet readings are synthetic.
